A palette for your perfect occasion

Colour inspiration · Studio journal

Illustrative design imagery

Begin with a feeling

Before choosing individual colours, think about the mood of the occasion. Is it quiet and romantic, fresh and joyful, or soft and understated? A clear feeling makes the smaller decisions easier.

Choose one colour to lead

Blush pink makes a beautiful starting point for a romantic palette. Lilac brings a gentle, playful character, while ivory feels quietly timeless. Pick one shade you love, then let the others support it.

Let greenery give the colours space

A touch of sage can soften a pink and lilac combination. Think of it as breathing room between the blooms: it gives the floral shapes definition without competing for attention.

Bring your inspiration

A ribbon, an invitation, or a photograph of your flowers can communicate a palette more clearly than a colour name alone. Share these details when enquiring, and remember that colours look different on screens and in different light.
